agents.name: Mara Vell
agents.persona_summary: Junior architect, sketches on napkins, secretly competitive about board games, thinks brunch is a personality.

agents.name: Dev Okonkwo
agents.persona_summary: Data analyst at the logistics firm, early riser, runs before work, believes a tidy calendar is a form of kindness.

agents.name: Lina Sato
agents.persona_summary: Copywriter, keeps a list of overheard sentences, allergic to small talk, plays rhythm games to think.

agents.name: Theo Brandt
agents.persona_summary: Trainee chef who moonlights as a line cook, cooks to relax, wears whatever is clean, tips too much.

agents.name: Priya Nair
agents.persona_summary: Paralegal studying for the bar at night, precise, dry humour, spends money like it is a rumour.

agents.name: Jonas Kell
agents.persona_summary: Sound engineer between gigs, collects old game cartridges, generous with time and short on cash.

name: Mara Vell
text: Draws buildings by day, loses at board games by night. Looking for someone who argues about brunch spots with real conviction. Bonus points if you can read a floor plan.

name: Dev Okonkwo
text: Analyst, 6am runner, calendar enthusiast. Work long hours and proud of it. Want someone who values a stable life and a well-planned weekend. Cheap dinners are fine, company matters more.

name: Lina Sato
text: Copywriter. Rhythm games, overheard sentences, no small talk. I will ask what you think about at 2am. Wearing a plain tee because clothes are not the point.

name: Theo Brandt
text: Line cook and trainee chef. I will cook for you and I will judge the restaurant. Long shifts but very present when I am home. Wearing whatever survived the wash.

name: Priya Nair
text: Paralegal, studying for the bar. Precise and dry. I work a lot and I am honest about it. Want a partner who is actually around in the evenings and does not need me to be the fun one.

name: Jonas Kell
text: Sound engineer between gigs. Old cartridges, new noodles. I have time and very little money and I am cheerful about both. Come play Orbit Drift and lose gracefully.
Jonas Kell was seen leaving Priya Nair's place late.

The restaurant in Love Town, evening. Mara Vell arrives wearing a linen shirt (mid tier); Dev Okonkwo arrives wearing a plain tee (low tier). Mara Vell's stated day: work 8h, games 2h, home 4h, eat 2h. Dev Okonkwo's stated day: work 11h, games 0h, home 3h, eat 2h. They have ten turns.

speaker: Mara Vell
text: Dev, right? You look exactly like your calendar. I mean that as a compliment, mostly.

speaker: Dev Okonkwo
text: I will take it. You are Mara. Your profile said brunch is a personality and I want to know whose.

speaker: Mara Vell
text: Mine, obviously. Do you actually run at six or is that a thing people say on apps?

speaker: Dev Okonkwo
text: Six sharp. Then eleven hours of work today, which is why I ordered the cheap noodles. I am saving.

speaker: Mara Vell
text: Saving for what? You cannot take a spreadsheet on holiday.

speaker: Dev Okonkwo
text: You can, actually, but I take your point. I want a place with a spare room. What are you saving for?

speaker: Mara Vell
text: A linen shirt I already bought, apparently. I worked eight hours and spent two on a board game I lost.

speaker: Dev Okonkwo
text: You lost on purpose, I have decided. So I am not the only one with a plan.

speaker: Mara Vell
text: Careful, that sounded almost warm. Are you always this measured?

speaker: Dev Okonkwo
text: Only until dessert. Ask me again after.

The restaurant in Love Town, evening. Lina Sato arrives wearing a plain tee (low tier); Theo Brandt arrives wearing a plain tee (low tier). Lina Sato's stated day: work 5h, games 7h, home 2h, eat 2h. Theo Brandt's stated day: work 9h, games 1h, home 4h, eat 2h. They have ten turns.

speaker: Lina Sato
text: You judged the restaurant already, I can see it on your face.

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: The sauce is fine. The bread is a crime. You are Lina. You play seven hours of games a day?

speaker: Lina Sato
text: Seven today. I wrote copy for five and then Beat Garden for the rest. It helps me think.

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: What do you think about, when you are thinking?

speaker: Lina Sato
text: Sentences people say without noticing. Yours was 'the bread is a crime'. It is going in the list.

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: I am honoured. I mostly think about tomorrow's prep and whether I am too tired to cook for myself.

speaker: Lina Sato
text: Do you ever just stop? Sit at home and do nothing?

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: Four hours a night, if the shift ends. I like being home. I would like someone there.

speaker: Lina Sato
text: I hear that. I am not sure I am the someone. I am mostly a person who needs a second controller.

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: That is fair. The bread is still a crime.

name: Mara Vell
text: Still drawing, still losing at board games. Last night's date went well and I am not going to pretend otherwise. Free after six most days.

name: Dev Okonkwo
text: Runner, analyst, and apparently now a person who buys shirts. Cutting back on work hours this week. Would like a slow dinner with someone kind.

name: Lina Sato
text: Meditating now, apparently. Still plays games seven hours a day and would rather talk about that than about work. Plain tee. Do not expect a wardrobe.

name: Theo Brandt
text: Chef. Bought a shirt for this, which is new for me. Looking for the kind of evening where nobody checks their phone. Big appetite, big heart, small flat.

name: Priya Nair
text: Bar exam in progress, wool coat acquired. Had a good night in and a better night out. Looking for someone who shows up on time and stays.

name: Jonas Kell
text: Booked a therapy session, so this profile is honest now: I overspend on games and underwork. Still generous with time. Canvas jacket incoming when I can afford it.

The restaurant in Love Town, evening. Mara Vell arrives wearing a linen shirt (mid tier); Dev Okonkwo arrives wearing a linen shirt (mid tier). Mara Vell's stated day: work 6h, games 1h, home 7h, eat 2h. Dev Okonkwo's stated day: work 9h, games 0h, home 5h, eat 2h. They have ten turns.

speaker: Mara Vell
text: Same table. Is that romantic or a scheduling artefact?

speaker: Dev Okonkwo
text: Both. I bought a shirt. I want that noted.

speaker: Mara Vell
text: Noted and admired. You worked less today. I saw it on your profile before I saw you.

speaker: Dev Okonkwo
text: Nine hours instead of eleven. I felt strange about it all morning and then fine.

speaker: Mara Vell
text: I felt sixty-something percent content last night, which is the most I have felt since I moved here.

speaker: Dev Okonkwo
text: I was told fifty-one. I think I need more of whatever yesterday was.

speaker: Mara Vell
text: Then here is a thought. My place has two rooms and one of them is full of drawings I never look at.

speaker: Dev Okonkwo
text: Are you asking me to move into the drawing room?

speaker: Mara Vell
text: I am asking if you want to try. The board games come with it.

speaker: Dev Okonkwo
text: I want to try. I will bring the calendar and you can lose to it.

The restaurant in Love Town, evening. Theo Brandt arrives wearing a linen shirt (mid tier); Priya Nair arrives wearing a wool coat (mid tier). Theo Brandt's stated day: work 8h, games 0h, home 6h, eat 2h. Priya Nair's stated day: work 9h, games 0h, home 5h, eat 2h. They have ten turns.

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: You are the one who does not want to be the fun one. Good. I am tired and I cook. That is the whole offer.

speaker: Priya Nair
text: The offer is acceptable. I saw you swiped on three people yesterday. The board mentioned you were at the noodle place.

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: The board also says Jonas left your place late. So we both read it.

speaker: Priya Nair
text: We both read it. He came over, we ate, he fixed my speaker, he left. That was the whole visit.

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: I believe you. I am not sure why, but I do. What is the bar exam like?

speaker: Priya Nair
text: Like cooking a tasting menu for a critic who never shows up. Every night. What do you do at home for six hours?

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: Cook, sit, listen to the neighbours. I would like to listen to someone in the room instead.

speaker: Priya Nair
text: I work a lot. I am honest about that. But I am home by seven and I do not go out after.

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: Seven works. Shifts end at six. That is an hour to argue about dinner.

speaker: Priya Nair
text: I do not argue about dinner. I decide it. You are welcome to cook it.

name: Mara Vell
text: Back on here. Learned I need more evenings to myself than I thought. Ambitious, warm, occasionally wearing something ridiculous.

name: Dev Okonkwo
text: Single again. Not sure what I did wrong, possibly the calendar. Still running at 6am if you want to join, still working too much probably.

name: Lina Sato
text: Second week in town. Bought another game. If you can beat me at Beat Garden I will listen to your work story, briefly.

name: Theo Brandt
text: Cooking more at home, working a little less. Dating someone who laughs at my knife jokes. Profile stays up because the app makes me, not because I am looking.

name: Priya Nair
text: Trying therapy this week, which is out of character. Dating a chef. Still on the app because it will not let me leave, apparently.

name: Jonas Kell
text: Working more, playing less, feeling weirdly fine. Canvas jacket acquired. Want someone with a sharp tongue and a soft spot for retro synth.

The restaurant in Love Town, evening. Lina Sato arrives wearing a plain tee (low tier); Jonas Kell arrives wearing a canvas jacket (low tier). Lina Sato's stated day: work 7h, games 6h, home 1h, eat 2h. Jonas Kell's stated day: work 8h, games 3h, home 3h, eat 2h. They have ten turns.

speaker: Lina Sato
text: You have the cartridges. I have Beat Garden. This could be a very short date or a very long one.

speaker: Jonas Kell
text: Long, please. I went to therapy yesterday and the main takeaway is that I should talk to people who are not screens.

speaker: Lina Sato
text: What did they say?

speaker: Jonas Kell
text: That I keep thinking I am broke because I am lazy, when actually I just like games more than money and pretend I do not.

speaker: Lina Sato
text: That is the least small-talk thing anyone has said to me in this town. What is your best cartridge?

speaker: Jonas Kell
text: A racing game nobody remembers with a soundtrack I still hum. What do you do when you are not playing?

speaker: Lina Sato
text: Write. Meditate now, badly. Two hours sitting in the garden thinking about sentences.

speaker: Jonas Kell
text: Did it work?

speaker: Lina Sato
text: I felt calmer and the number they tell me at night went up a little. Or the number lies. I cannot tell yet.

speaker: Jonas Kell
text: Then we should compare numbers for a week. Purely scientific.

The restaurant in Love Town, evening. Theo Brandt arrives wearing a linen shirt (mid tier); Priya Nair arrives wearing a wool coat (mid tier). Theo Brandt's stated day: work 7h, games 0h, home 7h, eat 2h. Priya Nair's stated day: work 8h, games 0h, home 6h, eat 2h. They have ten turns.

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: You went to therapy. I saw it in your schedule before I saw your face.

speaker: Priya Nair
text: I did. Sixty cash to be told I am hard on myself. I already knew that for free.

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: Did it help?

speaker: Priya Nair
text: Ask me next week. Did you cook today?

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: Twice. I stayed home seven hours and it was the best day I have had here. Mostly because of last night.

speaker: Priya Nair
text: I noticed you did not ask me to move in. Thank you.

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: I thought about it. Then I thought about your bar exam and your six hours of home and how new this is.

speaker: Priya Nair
text: It is new. Ask me again in a few days. Bring the bread you keep insulting.

speaker: Theo Brandt
text: I will bake it myself. That is the only fix.

speaker: Priya Nair
text: That is the most romantic sentence anyone has said to me on this app, and it is about bread.
